// ALL settings live here (single place to edit).
return [{json:{
  INDEX_URL: "https://www.placidway.com/sitemap.xml",   // sitemap INDEX (listed in robots.txt)
  CONTENT_SITEMAPS: ["sitemap_articles","sitemap_packages","sitemap_news","sitemap_testimonials","sitemap_experiences"], // rotated by day
  CRAWL_DELAY_SECONDS: 10,    // robots.txt Crawl-delay: 10 (stricter than the 1 req/s limit)
  URL_INCLUDE: "",            // optional regex to further filter URLs ("" = all)
  FORCE_URL: "",              // set a URL to test one specific page
  APPROVAL_MODE: false,       // true => send draft to reviewer, wait for approval
  DRY_RUN: true,
  DEMO_BAD_POST: false,       // VIDEO ONLY: true => injects an unsafe line so guardrails block the post
  DEMO_FB_FAIL: false,        // VIDEO ONLY: true => sends an invalid token to Facebook (nothing is posted)
  //  ^^^ both MUST be false for normal operation              // true => never call Facebook (simulation)
  SCHEDULE_HOURS_AHEAD: 0,    // >0 => schedule on the Page instead of posting now (min 0.17h)
  FB_PAGE_ID: "YOUR-FACEBOOK-PAGE-ID",
  MODEL: "gemini-2.5-flash",
  REVIEWER_EMAIL: "reviewer@example.com",
  ALERT_EMAIL: "alert@example.com",
  FROM_EMAIL: "you@example.com"
}}];

const cfg = $('Config1').first().json; const s = $input.first().json;
const system = `You write one Facebook post for PlacidWay, a medical tourism marketplace. Friendly, clear, professional.
STRICT RULES:
- Use ONLY facts present in the SOURCE. Never invent facts, prices, numbers, statistics, or clinic names.
- NO medical claims, no promises or implied guarantees of outcomes, no "cure", "best", "safe", "painless", "guaranteed".
- Prefer neutral wording: "learn about", "explore", "read about".
Return ONLY JSON: {"hook": string, "lines": [2 to 4 short strings], "cta": string, "hashtags": [3 to 5 strings starting with #]}.
- Describe what the ARTICLE COVERS ("The article explains...", "Read about...", "Learn how..."). Never state what a treatment achieves or benefits.
- Never use these words: enhance, improve, boost, maximize, success, effective, benefits, best, advanced, expert, leading, safe, proven.
- Do not state any number, price or statistic.
- hook + lines + cta combined must be under 380 characters in total. Use 2 or 3 lines, each under 90 characters. Count carefully; shorter is better.
- Do not include the URL.`;
const user = `SOURCE TITLE: ${s.title}\nSOURCE SUMMARY: ${s.summary}\nSOURCE BODY:\n${s.body}`;
return [{json:{...s, request:{systemInstruction:{parts:[{text:system}]}, contents:[{role:'user',parts:[{text:user}]}], generationConfig:{responseMimeType:'application/json', temperature:0.4, maxOutputTokens:1500, thinkingConfig:{thinkingBudget:0}}}}}];

parameters.subject: =[Approval needed] Draft post: {{ $json.title }}
